issues.on_page: Line 39 Debt Service 5,376.00 (Sewer Fund column, printed under the 'Governmental:' heading)
issues.issue: Recorded as business-type because the column is the Sewer Fund. This is defensible and matches FY2023/FY2024, but the form prints it on a governmental row. The same applies to detail[17].

This is the only receipt line for the Water and Sewer funds, so 100% of business-type receipts are in 'other'. It is almost certainly utility charges, but nothing printed shows that, so per the 2026-11-12 ruling it stays as other. It is already marked review. The same applies to detail[13] and detail[15].
Both equity lines have no category field. The amounts are correct (32,591.86 and 46,175.82; their sum equals the printed 78,767.68).
